metadata.case_name: CHAN MOK YAU v. 黃吉利 AND ANOTHER

plaintiff.occupation_before: general labourer in a plastic recycling business

injuries.description: distal fibula fracture at his right ankle / bimalleolar fracture
source: His right ankle x-ray showed a bimalleolar fracture.
his x-ray showed he suffered a distal fibula fracture at his right ankle.
injuries.icd_description: Other specified injuries to the ankle or foot

manifestations.description: bruises over his right toes / bruises over the lateral side of his right ankle
reduced range of motion of the right ankle (stiffness; specific ROM reduced compared to left)
could not perform squatting initially; later could squat with mild pain or adapted posture
pain increases with prolonged walking for more than 1 hour and with weather changes
reduced walking tolerance on stairs (could only walk on stairs at a reduced speed)

treatments_received: work hardening training under a work rehabilitation programme at the Occupational Therapy Department
admission to Department of Orthopaedics and Traumatology of Tuen Mun Hospital

losses.category: Loss of ability to engage in sports and hobbies
losses.description: He used to jog and hike at least twice a month and exercised almost every morning. Due to the residual pain in his right ankle, he has lost interest in taking part in these activities after the Accident.
Residual right ankle pain, stiffness and reduced range of motion; mild limping gait; pain increases with prolonged walking for more than 1 hour; earlier could only walk on stairs at a reduced speed.

He would not be able to resume his pre-accident employment which required him to climb ladders and lift heavy objects of about 50 kgs and may need to change to a more sedentary job such as a watchman.
